limits: Low and Extra high codeccore have no published Code quality score: Grok 4.6's intent probe returned malformed JSON on both attempts (the codeccore memo line quoted with its double quotes unescaped, the line Grok also broke on under v3.7 and v3.17). Low and Extra high are judged on 22 of 23 runs; both runs passed their tests and are timed and priced.
Muse Spark 1.3 passed calibration with the one-gate allowance: repeatability (g11) fell 0.02 short, within the half-point the protocol allows for one gate.

Neon ran through a custom Antigravity agent limited to the default file and shell tools, so the web search tool Antigravity's default agent carries was absent; the agent's prompt body is Antigravity's own identity block, verbatim.

The Google AI Pro plan refused 40 attempts on its usage quota; each was classified infrastructure and rerun from scratch, so the sweep waited about nine hours in all. Four Extra high attempts were cut mid-task this way.

Antigravity updated itself to 1.6.1 once during setup, before any run; the pinned 1.5.12 binary was restored and its folder made read-only, which the updater skips. Run receipts written from the sweep tag still describe the update control as an environment variable, which did not stop the updater.
There is no Max level: Antigravity offers Neon at Low, Medium, High and Extra high only.
Frontier Code quality is the reviewed layer plus intent recovery and is never compared with Routine v1 Code quality.
One attempt per task and level, on the owner's Mac, local sandbox, flat 3-hour task bound, one task at a time.
publication_scope: Per-run scores, per-panel sub-scores, aggregates, judge protocol text, calibration verdicts and control means, integrity-audit verdicts, tool-call counts, raw tokens and API-equivalent cost estimates.
withheld: quirk answer keys (they describe hidden-test behaviour)
reviewer session identifiers and usage receipts
solver event streams and tool-call inputs
integrity_limit: Hash checks bind the export to frozen files; they do not prove that judges were unbiased or that no training overlap exists.
